note: The two plain-texture blits ironchests calls. Both are matched on the ORIGINAL 1.20.1 jar. 1.21.4 adds a Function<Identifier, RenderType> first parameter to class_332's blits and makes the full overload carry explicit region/texture sizes, so each old call gets a bridge that supplies the resolver and the missing sizes.

methodRedirects.evidence: 1.20.1 call: TexturedScreenRenderer calls class_332.method_25290(Lclass_2960;IIFFIIII)V (measured with `mcbridge1201 refs`). 1.21.4 has method_25290(Function,Identifier,int,int,float,float,int,int,int,int) - same parameter order after the resolver, measured with javap. The bridge adds RenderType.guiTextured via class_1921.method_62277 and forwards.

1.20.1 call: GeneratedScreenRenderer calls class_332.method_25302(Lclass_2960;IIIIII)V three times (measured with `mcbridge1201 refs`). 1.21.4's method_25302 takes twelve parameters (Function,Identifier,x,y,u,v,width,height,regionW,regionH,textureW,textureH). 1.20.1's seven-argument form forwards with region = destination size and texture = 256x256; the bridge reproduces exactly that, so the geometry matches the old convenience overload. This 256 assumption is the one piece of the bridge that is a convention rather than a measurement - flagged in runs/p254.
